problem: The second partial sum is mis-rounded in the last digit. With $\log 10^6=13.815511$: $x/\log x=72382.414$ and $x/\log^2x=72382.414/13.815511=5239.214$, so the sum is $77621.627$, which rounds to $77621.6$, not $77621.7$. The third value is consistent with this: $77621.627+758.454=78380.08\approx78380.1$. A check script with tolerance 0.1 would not catch the difference.
